jobs.occupation: PhD Student in iPSC Disease Modeling and Gene Therapies (f/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The Stem Cell Unit (https://umg.eu/scu) is dedicated to advancing precision medicine by applying patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) disease models. We generate and utilize iPSCs for cutting-edge research in genome editing, cardiac differentiation, tissue engineering, and disease modeling. By combining iPSC technology with CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing and state-of-the-art molecular and functional approaches, we investigate the pathophysiology of cardiomyocytes at genomic, omics, functional, and pharmacological levels. Our ultimate goal is to uncover novel mechanisms driving cardiomyopathy and heart failure and to translate these insights into personalized therapeutics and innovative gene therapies. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student who is eager to work at the interdisciplinary interface between basic research and translational medicine. In this role, you will establish advanced iPSC-based cardiac models and apply them in imaging-driven and functional high-throughput screening assays to identify novel therapeutic strategies.Your tasks- you will develop 2D and cardiac organoid models based on human iPSCs to study cardiovascular diseases- you will use CRISPR/Cas9 for the targeted genetic modification of iPSCs- you will produce AAV vectors for preclinical testing- you will establish suitable screening methods for imaging-based analysis- you will apply preclinical compound screenings and test AAV-based gene strategies to identify novel therapeuticsYour qualifications- university degree (Master or equivalent) in disciplines or fields related to biology, pharmacology or biochemistry- strong interest in stem cell research, genome editing, gene therapies, and cardiovascular medicine- first hands-on experiences in human iPSC culture, CRISPR/Cas technology, and general molecular biology- excellent written and spoken English; German is not required but considered an advantageWe offer- access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for stem cell research, genome editing, advanced imaging, and multi-omics analyses- an inspiring, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with strong translational focus- close collaboration with clinical and basic science groups within the University Medical Center Göttingen, Fraunhofer, and national/international consortia, as well as participation in the German Centers for Health Research (DZHK, DZNE, DZKJ)- an attractive research location in Göttingen, a vibrant hub of biomedical and cardiovascular research in Germany- support for career development, including mentoring, grant writing, leadership training, and opportunities to present at international conferences- a family-friendly workplace with flexible working hours

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter.
